The ar1icles specifically listed in Annex "A" hereof, as classified
under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as amended, shall be

The AICO rate provided in Annex" A'l shall be accorded to the AIGO
entity in Indonesia (PT. Nestle Confectionery Indonesia) effective 27 September 1999
and to the AICO entity in Thailand (Nestle Foods (Thailand) Ltd.) effective 26 October
1999.

In the event that any subsequent changes are made in the basic
(MFN) Philippine rate of duty on the articles listed in Annex "A" to a rate lower than the
AICa rate prescribed in Column 4 thereof, such article shall automatically be accorded
the corresponding
reduced rate of duty. Effective 1 January 2003, the final CEPT rate
on the subject articles shall apply.

listed in the aforesaid Annex" A" which are entered or withdra\M1 from warehouses
